name: the findings tally reads the live rows again
why: Reverts _countFindingRows() to tallying the rendered tbody. runFilter() REMOVES non-matching rows, so a filter that excludes the flagged rows drops their menu row (AUDIT.md §3.6) — the bug this spec was written for, on the "(N) WARNING ⚠️" button the ⚠️ WARNING menu replaced. Must fail on "A: a filter that hides".
